about.title: Building My Path from ECE to AI
bio: My name is Most. Rufaida Islam Rishat. I am a 2nd Year, 1st Semester Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) student at Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University (HSTU), Bangladesh.
I am interested in artificial intelligence, AI data annotation, AI training, model evaluation, data quality, and technology-driven problem solving.

As a native Bengali speaker with fluent English communication skills, I am particularly interested in Bengali-English language tasks, AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, and other human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
Alongside my academic studies, I am building practical skills in programming and technology, including C, C++, Python, spreadsheets, web research, and AI-assisted productivity tools.

My goal is to grow from an early-career learner into a strong technical professional who can contribute to real-world AI and data projects while continuously improving my engineering and problem-solving skills.
